bounded_cross_range_support.raw_source: function lastBreak(s){let best=-1;for(let c of LABEL_BREAK_CHARS)best=Math.max(best,s.lastIndexOf(c));return best}function wrapLabel(label,width,maxLines){width=Math.max(1,width);let lines=[],cur="",curW=0;for(let word of label.split(/\s+/).filter(w=>w!=="")){let ww=stringWidth(word);if(ww>width){cur!==""&&(lines.push(cur),cur="");let chunk="",chunkW=0;for(let[ch,cw]of measured(word)){if(chunkW+cw>width&&chunk!==""){let p=lastBreak(chunk),carry=p===-1?"":chunk.slice(p+1);lines.push(p===-1?chunk:chunk.slice(0,p+1)),chunk=carry,chunkW=stringWidth(carry)}chunk+=ch,chunkW+=cw}cur=chunk,curW=chunkW}else cur===""?(cur=word,curW=ww):curW+1+ww<=width?(cur+=` ${word}`,curW+=1+ww):(lines.push(cur),cur=word,curW=ww)}if(cur!==""&&lines.push(cur),lines.length===0&&lines.push(""),lines.length>maxLines){lines.length=maxLines;let target=Math.max(1,width-1),s="",sw=0;for(let[ch,cw]of measured(lines[lines.length-1])){if(sw+cw>target)break;s+=ch,sw+=cw}lines[lines.length-1]=`${s}\u2026`}return lines}function fitLabel(label,inner){if(stringWidth(label)<=inner)return label;let out="",used=0;for(let[c,cw]of measured(label)){if(used+cw+1>inner)break;out+=c,used+=cw}return`${out}\u2026`}
